title: A Punch of Waste
next_chapter_hook: The Fifth Elder's face turned gloomy, slowly descending from the high platform. His turbid old eyes flickered with sharp light, fixing directly on Chen Ji—'Chen Ji, have you concealed your true cultivation? Tell the truth!'

text.content: At the Tianqing Sect Martial Arena, morning mist had yet to dissipate. Hundreds of disciples formed a circle, holding their breath in concentration. Today was the first round of the Sect Competition. The lottery tube turned in the elder's hand, and every drawn slip moved countless hearts.

Chen Ji stood at the edge of the crowd, his Servant Disciple's gray robe starkly conspicuous among the richly dressed disciples. Whispered discussions circulated—'Does thattrash actually dare to participate?' 'He'll probably be crippled in the first round.' He ignored them completely, his gaze fixed on the lottery tube, the smile at the corner of his lips deepening.

The slip fell. Number seven. Chen Xuanfeng, a core sect disciple at the seventh stage of Qi Refining, once publicly stomped on Chen Ji's three ribs last year and forced him to kneel in the snow and kowtow three times. That handsome face was now filled with disbelief, quickly transforming into twisted euphoria—'Ha ha ha! Heaven favors me!'

'Chen Ji!' Chen Xuanfeng stepped forward, his golden Inner Disciple robe shining brilliantly in the morning sun. He looked down at this 'trash' before him, deliberately raising his voice, 'Today I will make you understand what it means to be—' He paused, a cruel smile curling at his lips, '—a toad that can never turn its life around.'

Chen Ji watched his performance quietly, but in his mind flashed the images from the Tianji Record Fragment—the blurry foresight告诉他 that this person would certainly be defeated within three moves. And he only needed one punch. Not more, not less, precisely one punch.

'Senior Brother Xuanfeng is mighty!' 'Waste, just admit defeat, don't embarrass yourself!' Agreements rose from all sides. Chen Xuanfeng savored the快感 of being the center of attention, drew the sword at his waist, its tip pointing directly at Chen Ji's throat, 'Within three moves, I'll make you crawl out!'

Chen Ji lowered his gaze to look at his own fist, the faint Qi of the fifth stage of Qi Refining circulating through his meridians. He suddenly found it rather amusing—this 'genius' couldn't even discern the气息 he was deliberately releasing—who was the realtrash?

A dull roar echoed across the martial arena. The dignified seventh-stage Qi Refining core sect disciple was sent flying three zhang, landing unconscious with foam at his mouth.

text.content: Chen Ji sidestepped the sword's edge, his fist shooting out like a spirit snake. It precisely struck the wrist of Chen Xuanfeng's sword hand. The force was perfectly calibrated, numbing his entire arm. The sword flew from his grip, his body stumbled, Chen Xuanfeng's face full of terror—'Y-you cheated!'

The entire arena fell into deathly silence. Those disciples who had just been mocking Chen Ji now stared wide-eyed, as if they'd seen a ghost. A fifth-stage Qi Refiningtrash, defeating a seventh-stage core sect genius with a single punch? What a joke!

dialogue.content: Chen Ji crouched down, gazing at the terrified Chen Xuanfeng, and softly laughed: 'Last year when you stomped on my three ribs, did you ever imagine this day would come?' He paused, standing up and brushing the dust from his gray robe, 'Rest assured, I've only returned one punch. After all—' he smiled faintly, 'I am atrash啊.'

text.content: The crowd erupted completely. 'How did he win?' 'What拳法 was that?' 'Chen Xuanfeng must have deliberately thrown the match!' Questions, exclamations, and whispered discussions intertwined. The script of atrash's逆袭 was truly playing out at the Tianqing Sect Martial Arena.

In the crowd, Su Qingyao's beautiful eyes narrowed slightly. She clearly saw the weight behind that punch—it was by no means the explosive power a fifth-stage Qi Refining cultivator should possess. She murmured softly, 'Chen Ji, how much have you been hiding...' Nearby, an old man in ink-colored robes nodded imperceptibly. The Tianji Record Fragment in his sleeve faintly warmed.

'Chen Ji!' Chen Xuanfeng, supported by his fellow disciples, shrieked with a distorted face, 'You must have cheated! I'll report to the elders!' He trembled all over, unwilling to accept this残酷 reality—being defeated in one punch by thetrash he despised most, what utter humiliation!

Now, who ended up crawling out?' He shook his head, his tone full of怜悯, 'Accept defeat gracefully, is that so hard to understand?'

text.content: 'Atrash defeats a genius, the world has indeed changed.' Chen Ji walked out of the crowd without looking back, his voice soft yet perfectly audible to those nearby, 'Senior Brother Chen, get well soon, try again next year.' He waved his hand casually, his demeanor as leisurely as swatting a fly.

Chen Xuanfeng was噎得说不出话, his face flushed red. The gaze of surrounding disciples made him如芒在背—those eyes held shock, suspicion, and undisguised contempt. He wanted to defend himself, yet found no words. Indeed, he had bullied Chen Ji before. Now facing backlash, who could he blame?

Just then, a dignified voice came from the elders' seats: 'Silence!' The Fifth Elder stood up, his gloomy old face sweeping across the entire arena before finally landing on Chen Ji. He slowly spoke: 'Chen Ji, what technique did you use for that punch just now?'

The entire arena fell silent once more. All eyes focused on Chen Ji, awaiting his answer. Mo Xiansheng's voice echoed in Chen Ji's mind, carrying a meaningfull smile: 'Little fellow, your good show has just begun. Remember, you're playing the pig to eat the tiger—but a pig that's too stupid won't work, and one that's too clever is even worse.'

Chen Ji took a deep breath, about to respond to the Fifth Elder's questioning, when the Tianji Record Fragment suddenly grew warm. His heart stirred, and blurry foresight images flashed—the next moment, he would face a storm of questioning. The Fifth Elder's gaze grew increasingly sharp, Chen Xuanfeng gnashed his teeth beside him, and even the other elders began whispering among themselves.
